bus.via: Hangzhou South to Shaoxing Passenger Center

trips.route_note: High-speed trains run directly from Hangzhou East station to Shaoxing North in under an hour, then metro or taxi into the old town.
trips.why: High-speed trains reach Shaoxing North in under an hour, faster than the bus and with easy onward metro or taxi to the old town.
know: Book high-speed train tickets ahead for weekend travel
Shaoxing North is outside the old town; use metro or taxi for the last stretch
Spring and autumn are the most comfortable seasons to walk the old town

trips.route_note: Take a high-speed train from Hangzhou to Deqing, then a local bus or shuttle up to the Moganshan mountain villages.
trips.why: The train covers the 41 km in about 41 minutes, quicker than driving and a good base for the Moganshan shuttle.
know: You still need a local bus or shuttle from Deqing up to the Moganshan villages
Moganshan is busiest and priciest in summer; weekdays are calmer
Bring cash or a transit card for the local mountain shuttle
